title: Juicy Sweet Uruguayan Hake Bake
description: A sweet and juicy pescatarian-friendly Uruguayan dish featuring petit pois, perfect for a weeknight dinner. Serve with crusty bread and a side salad for a delightful meal.
instructions: Season the hake fillets with salt and pepper.
Heat the olive oil in a large oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat.
Sear the hake fillets for 2-3 minutes on each side, then set aside.
Add the chopped onion to the skillet and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Stir in the honey, lemon juice, and petit pois. Cook for 2-3 minutes.
Return the hake fillets to the skillet and transfer to the preheated oven.
Bake for 12-15 minutes, or until the fish is cooked through and flakes easily with a fork.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley and serve hot.
